name: Handlehasp
description: Raise the rail diagonally across the body so the long arm points at the opponent's striking hand.

name: Vicious Spinpeg
description: Chop the long arm down from shoulder height onto a raised forearm or weapon hilt.

name: Elbowside Scorer
description: Fold the elbow tight and swing the rail up from below into the underside of a lifted guard.

name: Fleet Tap
description: Slip the rear foot back along the rail line so the guard follows the body away.

name: Fierce Shortshaft
description: Pack qi into the end of the long arm and hammer the wood or bone behind a raised guard until it gives.

name: Sidehandle Swat
description: Send a hard qi-charged thrust of the short end through the narrow gap between the opponent's arms.

name: Shielding Tonfashaft
description: Seat the handle deep in the palm and hold the long arm firm along the forearm to stop a cut.

name: Wild Gripbar
description: Rap the end of the handle post against the opponent's hand where it grips the weapon.

name: Buttressed Roundend
description: Let the wrist go soft as a blow lands so the rail slides it off along its length.

name: Rapbarrier
description: Hook the thumb web of the opponent's hand with the short end and press it down to spoil the grip.

name: Scudding Forearm
description: Shuffle backward in two small steps while the handle holds the guard steady at the chest.

name: Raw Rap
description: Meet an incoming weapon with the handle end and let a burst of qi shake the whole arm behind it.

name: Tapswat
description: Slap the flat of the rail across the face of the opponent with qi making the blow ring.

name: Static Rearend
description: Press the long arm across the opponent's lead forearm and push it down to start a pin.

name: Humrap
description: Keep the pin on the forearm and drag it across the body so the opponent turns off line.

name: Acrid Knock
description: While the pin holds poke the short end into the open flank under the trapped arm.

name: Sleet Forearmside
description: Root the heels and brace the rail against the chest so a shove cannot break the pin.

name: Draught Spinflip
description: Raise the free hand's baton and rap down on the knuckles of the pinned weapon hand.

name: Brawnjolt
description: Walk sideways along the pinned arm so the opponent must turn to follow your steps.

name: Sleet Jolt
description: Weigh the long arm down on a captured limb with qi so the opponent cannot lift it free.

name: Honed Shortshaft
description: Release the pin just as the foe pulls and hammer the freed elbow with a charged short stroke.

name: Rigid Tonfashaft
description: Rest the long arm hooked over the forearm so the bend of the elbow protects the ribs.

name: Entangling Rap
description: Throw the long arm over the extended wrist and pull back so the opponent leans forward.

name: Brawn Sidehandle
description: Rake the hooked end behind the opponent's knee to buckle the leg as it steps.

name: Pirouetting Forearmside
description: Stride in with the hooked arm held ready so any raised weapon is checked as you enter.

name: Static Spinflip
description: Catch the collar with the hooked end and draw it down with a qi pull that rips the stance open.

name: Honed Jolt
description: Sweep the hooked end low through both ankles with qi behind it and drop a charging opponent.

name: Spinpeg Barrier
description: Hold a tonfa along each forearm before the chest so the two rails frame the guard.

name: Ember Handlepeg
description: Jab with one short end and then the other in steady alternation toward the same ribs.

name: Hum Elbowside
description: Cross both rails to catch a descending blade in the fork and hold it still for a heartbeat.

name: Acrid Handlepeg
description: Swing the off hand's long arm back across the body and rap a flanking opponent.

name: Poisehandle
description: Open both arms outward at once so the rails sweep two incoming blows aside.

name: Brawnrap
description: Step to match the opponent's foot and mirror their pace while both batons stay in guard.

name: Draught Knock
description: Snap both rails inward onto the wrist or arm from opposite sides with qi at both ends.

name: Brasshandle
description: Roll both long arms in counter turns before the body and feed qi to keep the wheel unbroken.

name: Static Roundend
description: Flash the off rail high as a feint and drive the main rail into the exposed ribs with charged force.

name: Sleethandle
description: Hold the long arm against the forearm with the handle loose enough to turn on contact.

name: Barprop
description: Roll the long arm outward over the forearm so a descending blow runs off the back of the rail.

name: Brassrap
description: Roll the long arm inward and shove its end into the opponent's solar plexus after the block.

name: Brass Handlepeg
description: Rotate the rail down over the elbow to pad a kick or club aimed at the side.

name: Clay Forearm
description: Slide out of range on the rolling block's last turn so the opponent strikes only air.

name: Draught Roundend
description: Turn the rail through a hard cut with qi stiffening the roll so the blade skids off.

name: Brassbar
description: Let the blocking roll continue into a full spin and smash the opponent's weapon arm with charged force.

name: Clutching Tap
description: Hook the opponent's wrist with the long arm and turn it outward against its natural bend.

name: Discord Gripbar
description: Slide the rail under a straightened elbow and press up to lever the arm into a lock.

name: Acrid Gripbar
description: Strike the thumb web of a gripping hand with the short end to loosen the weapon.

name: Barbarrier
description: Brace the free forearm against the rail so the locked limb cannot be wrenched free.

name: Binding Forearm
description: Nudge the short end against the shoulder joint to turn the body away from its own weapon.

name: Brawntap
description: Slide a pace along the locked arm so the hold keeps its angle as the body moves.

name: Gripping Elbowside
description: Set the elbow lock and hold it with steady qi in the rail so the arm cannot bend.

name: Clutching Rap
description: Pry the wrist over with a charged twist of the long arm until the weapon falls from the hand.

name: Tonfahasp
description: Tuck both elbows to the ribs and hold the rails vertical so the body presents a narrow front.

name: Draught Rearend
description: Spin the long arm in a tight orbit inside the guard and rap the opponent's inner wrist.

name: Brawn Spinflip
description: Duck beneath the swinging arm with the guard held tight and step out behind the shoulder.

name: Vicious Rearend
description: Answer a grab with a short cuff of the long arm against the side of the head.

name: Rapslap
description: Spin the long arm through the opponent's thrust and carry qi into the cut that follows it.

name: Tonfaprop
description: Interlock the spin of both rails so qi holds a turning guard against rapid blows.
